reviews.reviewText:
MCQs were confusing and conceptual. Only 2 MCQs from Midterm. Mostly Final Term syllabus.
Questions:
- ICP-OES (Inductively Coupled Plasma Optical Emission Spectroscopy).
- Solid phase extraction.
- IR spectra of aldehydes and ketones (bands & intensities).
- UV spectroscopy.
- Hollow cathode lamp.
- Complementary colors.
- Solvent recovery and recovery of acids/bases from salts.
